name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Ecommerce Analytics & Conversion Optimization Professional

At Wix, contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. Builds executive dashboards and KPI reporting that turn funnel data into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
